Rusko opäť útočilo vo viacerých mestách na Ukrajine. Hlásia najmenej dve obete a niekoľko zranených.
Pri ruskom útoku na Záporožie zahynuli dvaja ľudia, ďalších desať osôb utrpelo zranenia pri úderoch v Žytomyrskej a Kyjevskej oblasti, informovali vo štvrtok ukrajinské úrady. TASR o tom píše s odvolaním sa na agentúru DPA a portál Ukrajinska pravda.
V Záporoží na juhovýchode Ukrajiny zasiahol ruský útok dom. Zahynuli pri ňom 37-ročný muž a 38-ročná žena, ktorí tvorili pár. Informoval o tom šéf vojenskej správy Záporožskej oblasti Mychajlo Semikin. Rusko na mesto útočilo aj pred necelými dvoma týždňami, keď zhodilo päť navádzaných leteckých bômb na bytové domy a zabilo 15 ľudí.

Weltweit hat es Millionen Versuche von Cyberangriffen auf Websites gegeben, nachdem am Mittwoch gravierende Sicherheitslücken in der Programmiersprache PHP bekanntgeworden waren. Angriffe mit Schäden wurden bisher nicht bekannt. Auch in Österreich wurden bisher keine Cyberattacken auf Websites gemeldet, hieß es am Donnerstag vom Innenministerium. Dennoch waren vorsorglich zahlreiche Seiten vom Netz genommen worden. „Diese Nervosität ist Teil des Plans gewesen“, meint Harald Kapper, Präsident der Dachorganisation der Internetwirtschaft (ISPA, Internet Service Providers Austria).

titulek: Poland detains second suspect in murder of Russian artist and Putin critic Semyon Skrepetsky
titulekPuvodni: Poland detains second suspect in murder of Russian artist and Putin critic Semyon Skrepetsky
shrnuti: Officers from Poland’s Internal Security Agency have detained a 22-year-old Georgian citizen in connection with the murder of Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky, said Tomasz Siemoniak, the coordinator of Poland’s intelligence services.

Skip to main content
Poland detains second suspect in murder of Russian artist and Putin critic Semyon Skrepetsky
October 22, 2026, 5:56 pm
Source: RMF24
Officers from Poland’s Internal Security Agency have detained a 22-year-old Georgian citizen in connection with the murder of Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky, said Tomasz Siemoniak, the coordinator of Poland’s intelligence services.
RMF24 identified the man as Makhmud A. The outlet reported that he helped the suspected killer, who had been detained earlier, by keeping Skrepetsky’s home under surveillance and gathering information about his habits.
Makhmud A. arrived in Poland the day before he was detained and was traveling with two other Georgian citizens. The other two were expelled from the country, RMF24 reported.
Makhmud A. was charged with aiding and abetting murder and illegally possessing weapons and ammunition. He denied the charges.
Russian performance artist Semyon Skrepetsky was killed on June 15 in the Polish city of Biała Podlaska. The first suspect in his murder was detained near Warsaw on June 18.…

Ruská tajná služba FSB zveřejnila v dubnu 2025 záběry, na kterých agenti v Soči zatýkají Rumuna podezřelého ze špionáže pro Ukrajinu. Agentura Reuters zjistila, že scéna vznikla v době, kdy byl muž už 4 měsíce ve vazbě.
Článek
Mladý muž v tmavě modré čepici s batohem na zádech jde parkem. Z dodávky vyskočí dva agenti a srazí ho na chodník. Jeden z nich mu otočí obličej ke kameře a anglicky se ho zeptá, jak se jmenuje. „David Adrian Kercso,“ odpoví zadržený. „Odkud jsi?“ „Z Rumunska.“
FSB k videu tehdy oznámila, že v Soči dopadla rumunského občana, který podle nich vynášel Ukrajincům informace o ruské protivzdušné obraně. Kercso, který vyrůstal v Anglii, dostal letos od krajského soudu v Krasnodaru 15 let vězení za špionáž. Proti rozhodnutí soudu se plánuje odvolat.

October 22, 2026, 3:24 pm
Source: Reuters
A Ukrainian citizen, Vadym Y., was detained in the German state of Brandenburg on suspicion of spying for Russia, Germany’s federal prosecutor’s office said.
According to investigators, the suspect had been in contact with Russian intelligence services through an intermediary since no later than July 2025. Prosecutors believe he collected military intelligence, including information on the production of armored vehicles, ammunition, and explosives, as well as on personnel and military facilities in areas intended to ensure the security of NATO’s eastern flank.
Some of this information was publicly available, while other information was obtained from representatives of the European defense industry.
The court is expected to consider a motion to place the suspect in pretrial detention on October 23.

US President Donald Trump posted photos early Thursday showing Hubbard smiling as he posed with US special envoy Steve Witkoff.

Russian law enforcement authorities have arrested former State Duma lawmaker from the Communist Party Oleg Mikhailov on charges of publicly justifying terrorism, his regional party team said Wednesday.
Mikhailov has headed the Communist Party branch in the northern republic of Komi since 2014 and served as a State Duma member between 2021 and September 2026. In last month’s parliamentary elections, he lost his seat to a rival from the ruling United Russia party.
Komi’s Communist Party branch said in a social media post that Mikhailov was arrested at a Moscow airport after returning from a vacation.
The charge against Mikhailov of publicly justifying terrorism stems from old social media posts in which he allegedly supported jailed sociologist Boris Kagarlitsky and leftist activist Sergei Udaltsov .

Germany's Federal Criminal Police Office detained a Ukrainian national, Vadym Y., on 22 October on suspicion of gathering information about NATO military facilities for Russian intelligence.
Source: a statement by the German Federal Public Prosecutor General's Office, as reported by European Pravda
Details: The Ukrainian national was detained in the Oder-Spree district of Brandenburg under a warrant issued on 15 October.
Advertisement:





Vadym Y. is suspected of acting on behalf of a foreign intelligence service.
According to law enforcement authorities, he had been in contact with Russian intelligence through an intermediary since at least July 2025.
He also collected military-related information in Germany, including details about the production of armoured vehicles, ammunition and explosives, as well as personnel and military facilities in areas responsible for protecting NATO's eastern flank.
Some of the information was publicly available, while the suspect deliberately obtained other details from individuals connected to the European defence industry.

Putin releases U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard, who fought on Ukraine’s side
October 21, 2026, 9:42 am
Source: TASS
Russian President Vladimir Putin said U.S. citizen Stephen Hubbard, who fought on Ukraine’s side and was convicted by a Russian court of mercenary activity, has been released. Putin made the announcement at the start of a meeting with U.S. presidential envoy Steve Witkoff.
Hubbard is already at Pulkovo Airport in St. Petersburg, Putin said.
Hubbard, who was 72 at the time, was sentenced in Russia in October 2024 to six years and 10 months in prison on mercenary charges. In the first days of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, Hubbard joined the territorial defense in the Kharkiv region, where he had lived for many years, and in April 2022 he was captured by Russian forces.
The New York Times reported the day before that Witkoff would try to secure Hubbard’s release during his trip to Russia in order to “to show the benefits of deal-making” with Putin.

Skip to main content
Russia’s FSB says it detained German citizen who fought for Ukraine
October 21, 2026, 9:13 am
Source: Interfax
Russia’s Federal Security Service (FSB) said Russian law enforcement authorities detained a German citizen who allegedly signed a contract with the Ukrainian army and deserted.
The man arrived in Ukraine in November 2025 and signed a three-year contract to serve in the Ukrainian armed forces, the agency said, but deserted because he had not received the money he had been promised.
The FSB did not say how he ended up in Russia. A criminal case has been opened against him on charges of mercenary activity.
According to the FSB, the man took part in combat operations in Afghanistan as part of the German contingent from 2004 to 2010. He also fought in the armed conflict in Somalia from 2006 to 2008, served as a mercenary in Syria from 2008 to 2010, and fought in eastern Ukraine on the side of the Ukrainian armed forces from 2016 to 2018, the agency said.

The building where Kyiv Mayor Vitali Klitschko owns an apartment is exempt from the scheduled power outages that affect most city residents, the news outlet Slidstvo.Info reported.
Klitschko’s apartment is in central Kyiv, in a building constructed in 1901 at 30/10 Bohdan Khmelnytsky Street.
In response to an inquiry from Slidstvo.Info, DTEK Kyiv Grids said the building and 10 other residential buildings are connected to a critical infrastructure facility. The company receives its list of critical infrastructure facilities from the Kyiv City Military Administration.

Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Za mřížemi klece pro obžalované vypadal jako kterýkoli ruský občan předvolaný před lefortovský obvodní soud v Moskvě. Tím spíš, že mu ruská zpravodajská služba FSB, která ho před soud dostala, rozmazala na snímcích ze soudní síně obličej.
Jenže potíž je, že 14. října v Lefortovu nestál ruský občan. Za soudními mřížemi se totiž ocitl Japonec, konkrétně reportér japonských novin Hokkaidó Šimbun, které, jak napovídá už jejich název, působí hlavně na severojaponském ostrově Hokkaidó.
Ale nejen tam. Dotyčný novinář totiž svou pracovní základnu nemá v hokkaidském ústředním městě Sapporu, ale v bezmála 500 kilometrů vzdáleném Južno-Sachalinsku, což znamená v Rusku.
A právě do Južno-Sachalinsku si pro dotyčného reportéra…

Byl jsem v Paříži a viděl jsem, jak ve městě světel zavládla tma — Deník N
Šéf francouzského svazu zaměstnavatelů MEDEF Patrick Martin před vyrabovanou restaurací (19. října 2026). Obchod padl za oběť nepokojům a rabování, ke kterým došlo o dva dny dříve během celostátních protestů. Foto: Alexis Jumeau, ABACA / Abaca Press / Profimedia
Komentář: V Paříži se výbuchy násilí surreálně proplétají s rytmem francouzského života.
Více o poslechu Deníku N
Přidat Deník N mezi oblíbené zdroje
Všechno je jednou poprvé, i zásah slzným plynem. Pokud jste se 17. října zrovna nalézali v Paříži, šance, že se vám to stane, byla poměrně značná. Plakáty, jimiž byly polepené ulice východní části města, ten den nazývaly „Revolucí 17. října“.
Tonton Lulu je jedna z těch typických, nikterak nabubřelých kaváren, na něž v Paříži natrefíte na každém rohu. Tato konkrétní se nachází na Avenue Ledru-Rollin, jen pár set metrů západně od náměstí Bastily. To se v této části města stalo epicentrem nepokojů, které vypukly pod záminkou nespokojenosti se stavem školství a pod hlavičkou „dne boje proti drahotě“. Off Hiiumaa island, German warship wrecks from 1916 are ticking ecological time bombs, holding thousands of liters of oil that could pollute Baltic Sea coastlines if released.
The German torpedo boats S57 , V72 and V75 sank in November 1916 after straying into a minefield during a failed attack on the port of Paldiski.
A new study by researchers from the Estonian Maritime Museum (EMM) and Finland, led by Ivar Treffner, assessed the wrecks and the environmental threat they pose.
At the time, navies had only just begun transitioning from coal to liquid fuel. The ships went down carrying thousands of liters of heavy fuel oil, which remains trapped inside their hulls today.

Litva posilní fyzickú a technickú ochranu lokalít kritickej infraštruktúry po tom, ako v krajine došlo k pokusu o podpaľačský útok na zariadenie satelitného systému Starlink. Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni is poised to approve emergency security measures, according to local media, after protests over rising costs broke out into violent clashes in Milan.
The measures include extending preventative detention to minors and restricting group gatherings, Milanese paper Corriere della Sera reported.
Police deployed tear gas and water cannons after protesters - many in masks - threw paving stones, bins and chairs at officers over the weekend. More than 250 people were detained, 80% of whom were minors, Italian police said.
The expected crackdown comes after Meloni chaired an emergency security meeting on Monday afternoon. No official announcements have been made.

shrnuti: In August, a sabotage attempt took place at Leipzig Airport in Germany, which the German government has said was carried out by Russia. One of the suspected organizers of the attack is a Latvian citizen by the name of Oļegs Ļevuškins (Oleg Levushkin).

Ella Semjonova (LTV "De facto" pētnieciskā žurnāliste)
In August, a sabotage attempt took place at Leipzig Airport in Germany, which the German government has said was carried out by Russia. One of the suspected organizers of the attack is a Latvian citizen by the name of Oļegs Ļevuškins (Oleg Levushkin).
The Latvian Television programme investigative programme De Facto revealed on October 18th that Levushkin had been in business in Russia for almost 18 years as the owner of a Latvian pharmaceutical company called "Elpis".
The State Security Service (VDD) confirmed to De Facto that it has already initiated the procedure to revoke Levushkin's Latvian citizenship.
Leipzig Airport is one of the main routes for delivering military aid to Ukraine. On the evening of August 4 this year, a drone crashed into the wing of a Ukrainian cargo plane there, very close to its fuel tank. The drone contained explosives, but the detonator did not go off.…

Experts are warning that in the internet age, every connected device is a potential threat, following a cyberattack on a grocery store's refrigerators in France last week.
Hundreds of grocery stores in France were hit by a cyberattack on October 11 when hackers raised the temperature of refrigerators to as high as 50 degrees Celsius. As a result, large quantities of food were spoiled.
Technology expert Glen Pilvre said the damage was huge, running into millions of euros. He said the incident is a reminder that everything is connected, and if the locks on those connections are a little loose, someone can sneak in.
Security vulnerabilities

An Austrian Airlines flight from Israel to Austria was forced to divert to Bulgaria after a reported bomb threat.
The Airbus A320 plane was travelling from Tel Aviv to Vienna on Sunday night but made an emergency landing in Sofia, where passengers were evacuated, the Bulgarian transport ministry said in a statement.

Skip to main content
Advertisement
The cyberattack last week that hit hundreds of French supermarket refrigerators had Europeans wondering if the nonstop warnings about AI risks had finally landed in the real world.
They hadn't — at least, not yet.
Experts say the attack, which forced hundreds of retailers to throw away defrosted food and spoiled milk, was mostly a reminder of the importance of old-school cybersecurity in safeguarding essential goods and services.
Advertisement
The attack is a “typical example” of how “low-key cyber-enabled sabotage can affect very crucial supply for society,” said Ferdinand Gehringer, hybrid threats lead at FTI Consulting.
It’s arguably the most consequential hack in the European Union this year, with tangible, disruptive real-world repercussions. France’s Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu personally managed the fallout, which prompted coordination and information-sharing at the EU level. 
The perpetrators, whose identity and motives are currently unknown, hacked into digital systems to remotely raise the temperature of refrigerators in supermarkets…

Auf dem Weg von Tel Aviv nach Wien ist ein Flugzeug von Austrian Airlines in Bulgarien notgelandet. Offenbar hatte es zuvor eine Bombendrohung gegen die Maschine gegeben. Die Hintergründe sind noch unklar.
Wegen einer Bombendrohung ist ein Flugzeug von Austrian Airlines auf dem Weg vom israelischen Tel Aviv in die österreichische Hauptstadt Wien in Bulgarien notgelandet. Die Besatzung habe sich für eine Landung in der Hauptstadt Sofia entschieden, teilte das bulgarische Verkehrsministerium demnach mit. Die Passagiere seien nach der Landung in Sicherheit gebracht worden.
An Bord hatten sich 51 Passagiere und sechs Besatzungsmitglieder befunden, wie Austrian Airlines der Nachrichtenagentur AFP mitteilte. Nach der sicheren Landung sei eine Durchsuchung der Maschine eingeleitet worden. Sobald diese abgeschlossen sei, würden die Passagiere schnellstmöglich auf alternative Flüge umgebucht, erklärte die Fluggesellschaft.

Limoges: Residents in shock after historic town hall set alight - BBC News
'Very upsetting': Residents in shock after historic French town hall set alight
'Very upsetting': Residents in shock after historic French town hall set alight Close
A historic town hall in the French city of Limoges has been damaged in an apparent arson attack following a day of nationwide protests on Saturday.
Dramatic footage shared online shows the 19th-century building engulfed in flames, with the spire of its clock tower later collapsing.
On Sunday, stunned residents watched as firefighters, who had battled the blaze through the night, assessed the building's structural integrity. Officials have not yet confirmed whether the town hall is at risk of collapse.
"Damaging heritage buildings because you're angry with the government is selfish", one resident told the BBC.
BBC correspondent Chris Bockman reports from Limoges.
